findings.description: The code does not validate the input size `N` from the command line argument.
The code does not handle potential race conditions when multiple child processes access shared memory simultaneously.
The code does not check for errors when allocating shared memory or attaching to it.
`atoi` does not handle errors or invalid input. It should be replaced with `strtol` for better error handling.
The `while (wait(NULL) > 0);` loop can potentially lead to an infinite loop if `wait` fails.
